sections.Profile:
"Asteroid Annie and the Aliens," released by Gottlieb in December 1980, is a rare solid-state pinball machine with only 211 units produced. The game features two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball, focusing instead on skill shots and classic pinball mechanics. The machine is set in a sci-fi theme, with artwork by Gordon Morison and a design by John Buras.
